card.name: Numbers in estimated shares and amounts
card.fires_on: The space or first digits of a number right after phrases like "as much as", "equal to", "responsible for" or "about" in an estimate. Seen mostly in climate and prevalence statements.

modes.label: Space before estimate
modes.description: The space just before a figure that follows a hedging phrase such as "as many as" or "about".
modes.example: as much as<< >>15 percent of the population has R

modes.label: Leading digit of estimate
modes.description: The first digit of a figure in a claimed share or multiple.
modes.example: could have as much as <<6>>0 percent of the current global warming effect

card.writes: It seems to push toward the digits and number text that complete an approximate figure.
card.plain: It lights up when a text is about to give a rough estimate, such as "as much as 15 percent".
